status: OSM-based current-layout exterior draft; not measured or complete conservation replica
limitations: OSM is a crowdsourced map, not an official survey or conservation measured model; footprint, heights, roofs and names may be incomplete or inaccurate.
732 rendered parts lack the original height tag: a flat 6 m draft thickness above min_height is explicitly assumed, not measured.
1743 rendered parts have one or more documented assumptions; missing colours, shapes, roof rises and dimensions must not be presented as verified reconstruction.
Terrain and a common elevation datum were not measured. OSM horizontal coordinates are projected with ellipsoid height 0; building heights use the local ground convention.

The official 753×961 m overview and the OSM axis-aligned ENU boundary bbox (~785.513×1062.555 m) use different geometric definitions. Source boundary includes the southward projecting Meridian Gate wings and is oblique to ENU axes. Remaining differences require survey-level verification; never stretch or rescale the true geometry to force equality.

This draft does not reconstruct measured dougong, roof ornaments, tile modules, painted decoration, interiors, repair status or every extant component; an image with many pixels does not prove architectural fidelity.

projection.elevation_note: Horizontal OSM coordinates use ellipsoid height 0 for projection; building heights use local ground datum; terrain is unmeasured
